title: int:Trade
description: A matched and settled energy trade between a buyer and a seller. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument.

tradeId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:tradeId. UUID v4.

marketId.description: FK to Market. IRI: int:marketId. UUID v4.

bidId.description: FK to bid Order. IRI: int:bidId. UUID v4.

buyerId.description: FK to buying Actor. IRI: int:buyerId. UUID v4.

residualBidId.description: FK to residual bid Order. IRI: int:residualBidId. UUID v4. Nullable.

offerId.description: FK to offer Order. IRI: int:offerId. UUID v4.

sellerId.description: FK to selling Actor. IRI: int:sellerId. UUID v4.

residualOfferId.description: FK to residual offer Order. IRI: int:residualOfferId. UUID v4. Nullable.

tradeQuantity.description: Traded energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:tradeQuantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

tradePrice.description: Settled trade price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:tradePrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

tradedAt.description: Timestamp when the trade was created/matched. IRI: int:tradedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
